_provenance.covers: A local styles array with a widescreen breakpoint variant alongside desktop/tablet/mobile — widescreen is the one breakpoint that is min-width, not max-width (Blueprints.md §2.9)
_provenance.capturedVia: Built by hand in Elementor's editor (human), captured via `wp post meta get 5 _elementor_data` (EMCP-008). Widescreen had to be added to Site Settings -> Layout -> Breakpoints first — it is not in the active set by default on either sandbox.
_provenance.directionNote: The raw _elementor_data here only names the breakpoint ("widescreen"); it does not itself say min-width vs max-width. That comes from Elementor's Breakpoints_Manager, already confirmed live in EMCP-004's GET /site capture: widescreen direction="min", every other breakpoint direction="max". A DSL compiler consuming this fixture needs both this element shape AND that direction metadata to invert widescreen correctly.
_provenance.extractionNote: This widget was one of five top-level elements on the source page (shared with the unicode-roundtrip and mixed-v3-v4 fixtures). Extracted here in isolation, now carrying local styles it didn't have when the unicode-roundtrip fixture was captured from the same element.
